reserve.hollar.title: About HOLLAR
reserve.hollar.description: HOLLAR is a native decentralized, collateral-backed stablecoin that maintains its $1 peg while generating yield for holders. Built with advanced stability mechanisms, HOLLAR offers enhanced security through partial liquidations that protect more of your collateral than traditional lending protocols.
